# Probes of the v2 law identifier: the same file is read by scripts/law_id_v2_reference.py (an
# independent implementation in standard-library Python) and by tests/law_id_v2.rs (the crate's
# LawIdHasher); both must compute every expect line. Strings are written as UTF-8 hex.

probe no values
kind 70726f62652f7632
semantics 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
expect a2d4e20cae009bc7657cbdd5ce6442b3e0efc391fe1fd449af2ad1295ec8b30f
end

probe empty kind
kind
semantics 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
expect 6a34afd85aba57b2b57431f466b94c642a1360c4eb093c36e8dcdc658f72cac4
end

probe every value type

semantics 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111

value u64 5
value str c3a9

expect 5541ed9c75f0b3b10afde6eb87699433b40f11f44b211803923fd0f2d8f46e84
end

# Floats enter by their bits (written here in hex): -0.0 and +0.0 differ, f32 and f64 of the same
# number differ, the canonical NaN is accepted and every other NaN is refused.

probe f64 plus zero
kind 70726f62652f7632
semantics 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111
value f64 0000000000000000
expect 609864bf8b1f2af6f30b95b5ba6b881c479d3916a244b318a5aebce81e4cdcd3
end

probe f64 minus zero

semantics 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111111

expect aed9f705c4c5fd3a7b28c703cbd9732e3631f9d67ea4d8ae63c6431f62b5f0b2
end
